title: QA Arranging dried stems in a vase
summary: Arrange dried stems by inserting each into the vase, ensuring a neat, balanced display.

steps.title: Insert First Item
steps.instruction: Push the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right.
steps.why: Place the item into the vase to begin the arrangement.
tips: Use gentle pressure to avoid damage
steps.narration_text: Step 1. Insert First Item. Push the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right.

quiz.q: Why do we insert the first item into the vase?
quiz.explain: Inserting the first item begins the arrangement.

quiz.q: Why is it important to align each new item with the previous one?
choices: To make the vase look taller
quiz.explain: Aligning items maintains balance in the display.

quiz.q: Why should stems be kept upright during insertion?
choices: To prevent the vase from tipping
quiz.explain: Keeping stems upright protects them from damage.

safety: Handle stems gently to avoid breakage.
Do not overfill the vase to prevent tipping.
Keep the work area clear of sharp objects.
